create_DictVectorizer_fit_transform: create a DictVectorizer to transform a list of feature dictionaries into a sparse or dense matrix
test_DictVectorizer_feature_selection: test DictVectorizer with SelectKBest feature selection to restrict features by chi2 scores
test_DictVectorizer_one_hot_encoding: test DictVectorizer one-hot encoding of categorical string values into prefixed feature names
